title: Account operations.
caption: The first column gives the newer source API; the second gives the immutable evaluated pin and testnet-preview API. The embedded driver maps its grant names to the pinned exports and also uses `apply_account_doc` as a presentation alias for `apply_doc`; it does not change the contract ABI or the recorded evidence. *Owner authorization* means an account-document rule that targets the account and whose function policy allows the entry point; a rule with no function list, like the constructor's, allows all of them. [`docs/account-interface.md`](https://github.com/bitswell-hq/stellar-registry__perch/blob/f0275f41c5ab47c903bbfe9986b4bf3239c01b11/docs/account-interface.md) lists the account's other entry points.
